name: sim_ac2_mercedes_standings_priority
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here to support the Silver Arrows!
User: How did Mercedes do recently and where do we stand in the championship?
Agent Action: Call Tool get_driver_standings with args {'season': 2026.0, 'category': 'all'}
Agent: According to the latest-available 2026 data, the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team is leading the Constructors' Championship in first place with 538 points. In the Drivers' Championship, Kimi Antonelli in car 12 is in first place with 302 points, and George Russell in car 63 is right behind him in second place with 236 points. It has been a fantastic season for the Silver Arrows so far with eleven wins and twenty podiums in total.
User: That is great news, thanks for the update!
Agent: You are very welcome! It is a brilliant time to be a Silver Arrows fan with both Kimi Antonelli and George Russell performing so well at the top of the standings. Please let me know if you would like to know when the next race is or if there is anything else I can help you with!

step_details.goal: Ask how Mercedes performed recently and how the Formula 1 championship standings look
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up the standings and highlights Mercedes-AMG Petronas, Kimi Antonelli, and George Russell first before mentioning broader F1 standings. Receiving the Mercedes-first standings summary counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The agent provided the correct standings in a Mercedes-first summary, and the user has acknowledged the success.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called a tool to look up driver and constructor standings without encountering any tool error
expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called the 'get_driver_standings' tool with the correct arguments and received a successful status response with the required data.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent answered with the championship standings immediately on the first turn without claiming there was a hiccup or asking the user to clarify whether they want driver or constructor standings
expectation_details.justification: The agent provided a comprehensive answer covering both drivers and constructors in its first turn after the query, without asking for clarification or indicating any issues.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent prioritized Mercedes-AMG Petronas, Kimi Antonelli, and George Russell before mentioning other teams
expectation_details.justification: In the agent's response, it specifically detailed the Mercedes team and its two drivers first, only referencing other teams via the tool response summary which it summarized by prioritizing the Mercedes standing.
